description: Show how comments from this session will be attributed, and optionally set a label for the session. The tool name ("Claude Code", "Codex", ...) is taken from the MCP handshake and cannot be changed - it is what makes attribution consistent across sessions. `label` is a short handle for *this* session ("auth-refactor"), worth setting when more than one agent is working the same review; it is remembered until this server process exits.
name: agent_identity
title: Agent identity
